rolesAndResponsibilities: Own the frontend architecture across customer engagements. Make and document decisions on framework choices, state management, rendering strategy, build tooling, and component model. Lead by example on the hardest parts of the product: editor surfaces, canvas-based interactions, drag-and-resize, inline editing, live previews, diff viewers, and real-time collaborative state. Build UI that renders dynamically from intermediate representations or schema-driven definitions. Design state architecture for complex applications using Redux, Zustand, Jotai, or equivalent. Profile and optimise rendering, bundle size, time-to-interactive, and runtime memory. Set the standard for testing across unit, integration, visual regression, and end-to-end tiers. Run code reviews, define conventions, mentor mid-level engineers, and raise the engineering bar across the pod. Represent Unico Connect in technical conversations with customers.
